execution: Sequential main-thread review; no subagents, per user AGENTS.md

findings.title: Default relaunch request is rejected by the existing instance
evidence: The launcher serializes argparse's default command as null, but AppControl.Open required a string
test_normal_second_launcher_request_presents_existing_app failed before the fix and passes after it
findings.fix: Accept absent/null optional commands, reject invalid non-null types, and send an empty command from the new launcher

findings.title: Stale web callbacks override a newer mode or page
evidence: Late reading extraction restored reading mode after cancellation
Expanded generation test also reproduced the direct Back path bypassing invalidation
Five navigation/mode cancellation scenarios, current-generation success and duplicate-result rejection now pass
findings.fix: Validate current tab, generation and menu ownership before applying JavaScript results; invalidate on navigation and mode changes

findings.title: Opening another game replaces the identity of the running session
evidence: test_new_open_request_cannot_replace_identity_of_running_game reproduced current-item replacement while RetroArch was running
The regression now preserves the first identity and reports an error
findings.fix: Reject a new item before mutating identity whenever the emulator process is running

findings.title: Save-and-return intent survives a rejected save or terminated session
evidence: A rejected auto-save left exit_after_save true and the earlier manual save then quit the emulator
test_game_exit_clears_save_and_return_intent failed during the second review and passed after lifecycle cleanup
findings.fix: Set exit intent only after accepting the auto-save request, and clear it on emulator exit

findings.title: Resume is allowed during pending save/load operations
evidence: test_pending_load_keeps_game_paused_and_keeps_menu reproduced an unwanted PAUSE_TOGGLE and early menu removal
The real RetroArch probe now checks resume rejection during both pending save and load
findings.fix: Reject resume while an operation is pending and clear the menu only after successful resume

findings.title: Downloads fail at the Qt Quick binding and outlive the valid request window
evidence: Real native probe logged: QQuickWebEngineDownloadRequest* cannot be converted
Qt 6.8 documents immediate destruction of requests unaccepted when downloadRequested returns
Real native probe now checks cancellation with zero writes, exact downloaded bytes, duplicate-name preservation and confirmation screenshots
Controller tests cover close, back, clearing menus, tab switching, overlapping requests, filename confinement and owned-menu cleanup
findings.fix: Keep Qt Quick requests in QML; pass primitive data to a modal Qt event-loop confirmation; accept/cancel before signal return and clean up progress by download id

findings.title: Directly opening another book loses the last position and retains old menus
evidence: Native PDF-to-TXT test failed because the new book kept the old contents menu
The same native test now checks saved page, zoom, x/y pan and one-step library return
Switching to a malformed EPUB also preserves the previous book's stored position
findings.fix: Persist the old document before closing it, clear document-owned menus/search and replace the document navigation level

findings.title: A malformed EPUB escapes the application error boundary
evidence: Opening a non-ZIP .epub raised zipfile.BadZipFile, outside AppController.attempt's catch tuple
test_malformed_epub_reports_a_format_error failed before the boundary conversion and now passes
Native Reader probe checks the recoverable format error and preserved prior position
findings.fix: Translate BadZipFile to an explicit localized ValueError at the archive-open boundary

findings.title: Software video hides embedded subtitles
evidence: Native video fixture delivered QVideoSink subtitleText while controller.subtitle_text() remained empty
The failing real fixture now asserts player text and visible QML text, and captures the composed embedded captions
findings.fix: Expose QVideoSink subtitle text and change notifications to the existing overlay in software rendering mode

advisory_only: Native automation does not establish physical controls, audio quality or arbitrary external websites
The upstream foliate-js modules were not modified or independently fully security-audited

local_pytest.skip_reason: Linux Terminal native plugin unavailable on macOS

verdict: ready to merge; all nine confirmed findings fixed and verified
